name: [☀️UPD1🎣] Zenith Inc
desc:
✨Welcome to Zenith Incremental✨

How to play:
🌌 Generate Zenith and climb the Stairs!
⚡ Buy Upgrades to multiply your power !
🎲 Roll at the Temple to earn Stars!
🔮 Unlock and expand the massive Skill Tree!
🔥 Rebirth, Awaken to unlock new realms!
🏆 Reach the top of the leaderboards and achieve the ultimate Zenith!

scripts.title: KEYLESS FAST STAIR CLAIMER
scripts.features: Get all ur stairs in less than a second
scripts.script:
x = 1
while true do

    local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ReplicaRemoteEvents.Replica_ReplicaSignal
    Event:FireServer(
        192,
        "RequestUpgrade",
        "ground_upg" .. x,
        "max"
        
    )
    x = x + 1
    if x > 100 then
        x = 1
    end
    task.wait(0.01)
end
